scope: Exact declared observer reductions and experiment-specific provenance; physical calibration is separately evidenced

exact_serialization.printed_values: original decimal string with source precision retained

requirements: independent reference realization and observation map

apparatus_profiles.hydrogen: continuous maser heterodyne and source-bound correction chain
apparatus_profiles.cesium: driven fountain, two interactions, calibrated fluorescence population estimator

invariants: whole artifact replay for every native-linked product
observer passivity and no future cut access
source aggregates excluded when their components already enter same budget
no packet/cycle/closure identification without observation map
limits: No independent atomic frequency from SI normalization
No nuclear kernel or lifetime fit
No promotion of printed-input replay to raw experiment reproduction
No new awareness, path-integral or universal complexity premise

comparison_assessment.compatibility: Additive declared-assessment interface; existing observation records and reductions unchanged
comparison_assessment.authentication: Complete assessment declaration and endpoint quantities are separately bound to supplied trusted sources
comparison_assessment.evaluation_method: Type_A and Type_B describe methods of uncertainty evaluation, not random or systematic error classes
comparison_assessment.condition_transfer: An applied effect inferred at a different location requires independently bound transfer scope; an external ambient field is not the internal apparatus field
comparison_assessment.windows: Observation cuts retain coordinate and epoch; a separately declared reflection duration has its own coordinate and no implicit observation or SI map
comparison_assessment.dependency_identity: Shared source payload digests remain shared under identifier aliases; absence of detected overlap does not establish independence
comparison_assessment.materiality: A bound below a positive tolerance requires authenticated influence, window, coordinate, epoch and common output unit; it does not certify a complete physical budget
comparison_assessment.arithmetic: Exact supplied prediction minus supplied comparison; previously applied corrections are never applied again
limits: No inferred probability distribution or physical acceptance score
No certification of independent physical validation
Unknown residual uncertainty and applicability remain explicit
